name: Append PDF files
description: Combines the PDF files listed in the input records, in record order, into one PDF file, with an optional bookmark for each file.
introductoryText:
Combines several PDF files on the Omniscope server into one, in the order of the input records, and writes the combined file to a folder.

**How to set it up**: connect records with one PDF file name each (for example from a File block with a list, or a folder listing), choose that field and the folder the files are in. Optionally choose a field of bookmark titles: each file then gets a bookmark in the combined PDF. Choose the output folder (empty: the input folder) and the file name.

**Output**: the input records with the combined file's path, each file's page count and the page it starts on in the combined file.

options.name: input_folder
options.title: Folder of the PDF files
options.description: The folder holding the PDF files (choosing a file inside it also works). Empty if the file name field holds full paths.

options.name: pdf_file_names
options.title: PDF file names
options.description: The field with one PDF file name per record, such as report.pdf, or a full path. The files are combined in record order.

options.name: title
options.title: Bookmark titles
options.description: Optional: a field with a bookmark title for each file. Records with an empty title get no bookmark; leave the option empty for no bookmarks.

options.name: output_folder
options.title: Output folder
options.description: The folder to write the combined PDF to. Empty: the folder of the PDF files.

options.name: file_name
options.title: Combined PDF file name
options.description: The name of the combined file, such as board-pack.pdf (.pdf is added if missing). An existing file of that name is replaced.

blockOutputs.label: Combined
blockOutputs.tooltip: The input records with the combined PDF's path (Combined PDF), each file's page count (Pages) and the page it starts on in the combined file (First page).
